summary: Entry on the statewide Georgia list at Oak Mountain, Carroll County, 1,360 feet; no source found gives the tower's history or its site today.

evidence.supports: oak mtn listed in Carroll County at 1,360 ft, with BLL-63469 and gfc-401 tags
county plan: Oak Mountain just east of Carrollton; view superb in every direction
evidence.quote: the view from Oak Mountain, just east of the City of Carrollton, is superb in every direction

sources.title: Carroll County, Georgia Comprehensive Plan Update 2018, Chapter 2: Natural and Cultural Resources

notes_for_editor: Only the statewide list (coordinates, elevation, two registry tags) and the county plan's description of the mountain. Two web searches found no tower history, and the NHLR Georgia index does not list an Oak Mountain tower. The 2018 date comes from the document title in search results. The BLL tag is kept as the list prints it; its expansion is not known. Ownership and public access are unverified, and the story says so. Brief's access 'unknown' is unchanged.
